aitareya_chapter3_verse4.title: Aitareya Chapter 3 Verse 4
aitareya_chapter3_verse4.introduction: This verse belongs to Aitareya, Chapter 3.
aitareya_chapter3_verse4.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Aitareya Upanishad, Chapter 3, Verse 4, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
aitareya_chapter3_verse4.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
